turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. You have twenty-five minutes of mine, and you've just spent one on coffee. Who entered that zero before anyone spoke to me?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Don't manage me, Hale. If he's one of your favourites, then why are we here? Answer the question.
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.

"Aren't perfect." Even the company that sells it says the indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and I have that printed in my bag. So what else do you have, or is a machine's guess the whole case?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing that down: created at 11:31 PM, 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58. What date, and whose file is that? Turn the screen so I can read it myself.
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Save it, Hale. You didn't answer me. What date, and turn the screen.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
That's not Owen's problem, and I'm not here to grade you. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office before my call. What date is on that file?
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.

"Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings." I'm writing that down word for word, and I'll be checking it against the play tonight. Did you ask Owen where it came from before you entered the zero, Hale?
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.

"Completely different direction" is an adjective, Hale, not a document. Put the October 15 outline and the essay side by side on that screen, with the date on the file history. And you still haven't told me whether anyone heard Owen before that zero went in.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? Your partner's bets aren't on my agenda, and I have a call at 4:40. Owen.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
"Nothing goes on his record." Whatever happens, that stays true and this stays quiet, and I want it in writing before I leave this building. Ten minutes, Hale, and I still haven't seen that screen.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You're asking me how to talk to my own son about your mark? You talk to me, in writing, and I'll talk to Owen. Show me the outline and the file dates, or I'm going upstairs.
